source: Codex Trajectory structured local session statistics; sanitized aggregate only

scope.tokens: Main conversation and recursively related agents, counted once per task
scope.snapshot: Historical snapshot; excludes work after the cutoff, including making this report

limitations: Repeated context and cached input are included; token totals are not unique authored text.
Reasoning output is a subset of output, not additional tokens.
The log contains overlapping turn starts and mismatched item-to-turn events.
Five turns lack complete timing; active time is recorded coverage, not complete human work time.
Model-related time includes network, response and queueing estimates; it is not pure generation time.
Tool calls running in parallel count once in timing; gaps between turns are excluded.
A failed tool call is not equivalent to a shipped website defect.
Timing and token samples were read seconds apart; numbers are a fixed snapshot, not live counters.
No billing claim: subscription usage and token counts do not establish an actual bill.
